title: ScheduleSettings
description:
Workspace schedule auto-run settings (`docs/19`/`docs/38`).

Auto-run starts scheduled prompts with no human in the loop, so it is **disabled by default**; the desktop executor always starts but idles while disabled. `scan_seconds` is the poll period for due schedules.

enabled.description: Whether the desktop executes due `.zeokeel/schedules.json` entries.

scan_seconds.description: Schedule scan period in seconds (`5..=3600`; default 10).
